findings.claim: The test asserts stderr contains the literal 'no such file or directory', which is the Linux/Unix errno text. On Windows the message differs ('The system cannot find the path specified'), so the test would fail there. The exit-code assertion alone pins the behavior; the string match makes the test platform-dependent. Also, the path uses a non-existent parent directory, so it exercises a missing directory rather than a missing database file in an existing directory; the commit message claims a missing database.

evidence: The diff only adds one test function in a test file; no production code changed.
The test reuses helpers (syncMemorycardWorld, enterHookPath, runHookSync, realTempDir, renderPromoteGoldenTree) that are used by the neighboring existing test, so they are presumed to exist.
The only observed risk is the OS-specific error string assertion and the missing-parent-directory setup versus the claimed missing database.
